name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 6 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 35 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-11-06, at wavelengths from 1.18 to 4.94 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
